utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely, I can help with that. Tell me where you want me to start.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m a bit late, but I can take the next piece if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: No worries, Dane. Take the next piece and I’ll keep this moving from here.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can take a quick look at it with you.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Leo. Can we check the main connection first?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure, let’s start there.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can check what supplies we’ve got and see what’s still missing for the drive.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sure, I can help keep track of that.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, I’ll jot down what we have and figure out the rest together.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with that, but I need the details first.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can share the details, but I need to know when you’re coming and what materials you’ll bring.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can come by at 3 and I’ll bring a hammer, nails, and tape.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What still needs fixing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard the porch steps and a couple of loose boards are still on the list, but I’m not sure what else got added.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Do you know if the back fence or walkway was added too?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive’s getting a good bit of buzz already. Folks around here usually turn out if there’s coffee and a clear list of jobs.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Absolutely - I can bring my drill and a couple extension cords, and if folks send over the job list early, we can keep things moving.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Great, I’ll spread the word and make sure folks know to send that job list early so we can keep the day moving.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m spreading the word now, Opal. I can round up a few more neighbors if you want to get the repair drive moving fast.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, thanks. Let’s start with the repair drive at the east block first, since that’s where the most people pass through.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Got it, I’ll start lining people up for the east block and bring them over.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can help with that. What still needs fixing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm what’s still left on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can confirm what’s left: just the repair items that still haven’t been completed. If you want, I can list them out one by one.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, Bo. I’ve got the repair drive list ready, and I’ll make sure we match people with the right jobs.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, just point me to the list and I’ll help where I can.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, I’ll pull up the list and send you to the right section now.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I heard the repair drive’s coming up. I’ll tell Eli we’re on it.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good. Keep it simple and let me know the schedule once it’s set.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sure, I’ll keep it simple and let you know once the schedule is set.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right, the repair drive. I might’ve mixed up the date, but I can still help out if you tell me what needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yeah. I can show you what needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Great, show me where to start and I’ll follow along.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can help with the repair drive. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I could use a hand hauling supplies and checking the wiring. If you’ve got a ladder, bring that too.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect, I’ll bring the ladder and help haul the supplies.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I heard the repair drive is happening soon, and I can send around the details if you want.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, send them my way and I’ll take a look.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, I’ll send the details over right away.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I heard the repair drive's coming up. Tell me what still needs doing, and I can help where I can.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’ve got a short list started, and the driveway needs clearing, the spare bulbs changed, and the back gate fixed. I can walk you through the rest if you come by after breakfast.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can do that after breakfast. I’ll come by and help with the driveway and gate.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help after school if the timing works out. What do you need from me for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Faye. We need hands for sorting donations and checking labels after school, and if you can bring tape and a marker, that would help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Absolutely, I can do that after school. I’ll bring tape and a marker too.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can help with that, Vik. Tell me what still needs fixing and I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sure — I’ll send along what still needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Vik. I’ll keep an eye out for your update and pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure, I can lend a hand with that repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Gus. I’ll need to check the timing and whether we have the right parts before I can say for sure.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Pia. Let me know once you’ve checked the timing and parts, and I’ll be ready to help.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can keep track of which place needs what. Tell me where the repair drive is centered, and I’ll note it.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: It’s centered at the community center on Maple Street. I’ll have the rest of the places sorted there.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it. I’ll note the community center on Maple Street as the hub and keep the other places sorted from there.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What’s the repair drive for, exactly?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: It’s for fixing up things around the neighborhood that need attention, like small repairs and shared upkeep.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What kind of repairs are we talking about?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can help with the repair drive. Tell me what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got a short list: we still need wood screws, a drill battery, and someone to patch the back fence.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can take the screws and battery, and I’ll help patch the back fence too.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I only heard about it second-hand, but I can ask around if you need the latest.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, that’d help. I’m a bit behind on what changed with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I haven’t heard the full update yet, but I’ll check around and let you know what changed.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, Tess, the repair drive is still on for today, right?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, it’s still on for today. I heard the crew’s aiming to start mid-morning.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great, just wanted to confirm we’re still good for this morning.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard the repair drive is moving ahead; I can swing by after errands if you need another hand.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Ira. I might take you up on that if I’m still short-handed.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I can do that; I’ll check back after my errands and help if you’re still short-handed.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Hey Leo, I might be a bit mixed up, but I’m here for the repair drive and can help however I can.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, thanks. I’ll point you to the main stack and you can take it from there.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Got it, I’ll head to the main stack and start sorting things out.
